title: Finite coefficient comparison respects compact-support composition
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_r=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^r$ for $r\ge1$. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $m\ge n\ge1$, $A=A_m$, $B=A_n$, and $Q_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ on the small etale sites, or on the finite constructible pro-etale realizations [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $F_{h,r}=Rh_{!,r}$ for compact support [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, def-amb-etale-compact-support], $\alpha_{g,f,r}:F_{g,r}F_{f,r}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{gf,r}$ for its canonical composition isomorphism [thm-sf-comp-composition, lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons], and $q_{h,M}:Q_{\mathrm{target}(h)}F_{h,m}M\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{h,n}Q_{\mathrm{source}(h)}M$ for the canonical coefficient comparison [lem-fix-compact-support-coefficient-change]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, or its finite constructible pro-etale realization, where this means a bounded constructible complex of $A$-module sheaves on $X$ with finite Tor amplitude (there exist integers $a\le b$ such that tensoring $K$ with any degree-zero $A$-module sheaf has cohomology only in $[a,b]$) [lem-sf-flat-model, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the following equality holds:
$$
q_{gf,K}\circ Q_Z(\alpha_{g,f,m,K})
=\alpha_{g,f,n,Q_XK}\circ F_{g,n}(q_{f,K})\circ q_{g,F_{f,m}K}.
$$
Both sides are morphisms $Q_ZF_{g,m}F_{f,m}K\to F_{gf,n}Q_XK$. The comparisons on the pro-etale realization are the canonical ones for compactifications, with the site identifications of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison].

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), construction of the composition comparison, together with Tag 0GL6 (remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings); the displayed naturality square is an agent-explicit consequence of those constructions, not a verbatim assertion of either tag.

proof.text: Choose compatible compactifications by Nagata and the triangle lemma. Their proper ambient schemes remain finite type over the field, hence Noetherian. Here $A_m,A_n$ are finite $\ell$-power rings. The domain lemma gives bounded finite-Tor inputs, outputs and actual reductions; thus $q_g$ applies to $F_fK$. For intrinsic pro-etale input choose bounded constructible etale origin and reflect its Tor interval by the cited comparison lemma.

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition): compatible triangle and coefficient domains

proof.text: Apply the composition and refinement clauses of the cited etale/pro-etale coefficient-compatibility lemma with $A=A_m\to B=A_n$ (finite, killed by a power of $\ell$; $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ has characteristic $p\ne\ell$; all schemes separated of finite type over $k$) and $L=K$. Step 1 shows that $F_{f,m}K$ is again an allowed input, as its term $q_g(F_{f,A}L)$ requires. Its etale map $\beta_h$ is the proper counit-mate scalar map followed by the extension-by-zero tensor identification: these are the two factors of the projection construction, normalized as in the finite direct-image lemma, so $\beta_h$ is the canonical comparison $q_h$ of the statement. Its etale $\alpha$ and refinement maps are those of the etale compact-comparison theorem. Its composition equation is therefore the asserted etale equation, and its refinement square makes this independent of the chosen compactifications.

source.place: Tag 0GL6 (remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings) and Tags 0F7I, 0F7J: coefficient change compatible with refinement and composition of compactifications

proof.text: For pro-etale input choose, by step 1, a bounded constructible finite-Tor etale origin $L$ with witness $w:N_XL\cong K$. The pro-etale clause of the same lemma gives the composition equation at $N_XL$ for $q_h=b_h$, the proper adjoint transpose followed by extension-by-zero tensor comparison, which is the statement's pro-etale $q_h$; there $\alpha$ and the refinement maps are the transports through the site comparison $C$. Finite compact site coherence identifies these transports with the proper/open pastes computed on the pro-etale site, and the class compact-support comparison with the composition theorem identifies them with the canonical $\alpha$ of the statement. Conjugate by $w$: naturality of both sides gives the equation at $K$, and a change of witness or of common refinement cancels adjacent inverse comparisons.
